about: subagent_chat.py's script (owner, 2026-10-21: a sub-agent's chat shows as a chat; 2026-10-22: it is read only). "Worker task: stream slowly" is the sub-agent's only turn, about 25 s of text, so the window can look at its chat while it runs; what it streams is handed to the parent as the task's result.

steps.text: The worker reads each file in turn and notes what it finds, so the report at the end can say exactly what changed and why.
